listing.name: LittleBigPlanet — LittleBigRecomp (benjidotsh)
listing.summary: Upstream reports first-start save creation and the Introduction level. Intermittent bright wedges and depth/stencil rendering bugs remain. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Europe BCES00141 disc version 02.00 ISO and decrypted EBOOT.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the upstream source instructions to translate the game code and build locally.

warnings: Upstream reports first-start save creation and the Introduction level. Intermittent bright wedges and depth/stencil rendering bugs remain.
